commands.pettransfer.help.transfer: Transfer the pet you are looking at to an owner of your choice.
commands.pettransfer.help.confirm: Confirm you want to transfer your pet. (Can be bypassed via AutoConfirm boolean)
commands.pettransfer.help.accept: Accept a pet someone is transferring to you.
commands.pettransfer.help.credits: Print the credits for the mod.
commands.pettransfer.transfer.fail.noent: ERROR: You are not looking at an entity!
commands.pettransfer.transfer.fail.self: ERROR: You cannot transfer a pet to yourself, silly!
commands.pettransfer.transfer.confirm: Are you sure you want to send %1$s to %2$s? Run %3$s or %4$s to confirm.
commands.pettransfer.confirm.autoconfirm: AutoConfirmed! Now asking %1$s if they want %2$s.
commands.pettransfer.confirm.ask: %1$s would like to send you %2$s! Run %3$s or %4$s to accept.
commands.pettransfer.accept.gifter: %2$s accepted your transfer request! Successfully sent %1$s to %2$s!
commands.pettransfer.accept.recipient: Successfully received %1$s from %2$s! Be sure to thank them!
commands.pettransfer.credits: These are the credits of the people who contributed to this mod!
